info.title: RentnerProxy App Protocol
info.description: Stable version 1 contract for native apps. HTTP uses the declared private Unix socket for each operation. The matching SDK verifies cross-record invariants. Platform authorization is required at the runtime boundary.

get.summary: Read the handoff state of a built-in feature domain
get.description: A legacy feature domain equals a provider profile. Every handoff operation acts only for the active generation of the calling installation. The state platform means the platform still owns the domain. The state exported means this installation is importing a fixed export. The state committed means this installation owns the domain.

post.summary: Fence platform writers and fix a built-in feature export
post.description: Begin fences the platform writers of the domain and fixes one export of its configuration, credentials and history as ordered parts. The result state is exported, or committed after a completed handoff. Repeating begin returns the same digest and part count, so an interrupted import resumes.

post.summary: Commit an imported built-in feature export
post.description: Commit exactly the digest that begin returned, after every part is imported durably. Commit retires the platform state once and transfers ownership to this installation. The result state is committed. Repeating commit with the same digest returns committed.

x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.requests: Versioned requests and closed package, approval, credential and bridge records reject unknown fields. Omitted optional fields are absent. Null is valid only where explicitly declared.
x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.responses: Readers tolerate additional fields only in open response schemas. Unknown discriminants, required capabilities and security-relevant values are rejected.
x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.encoding: Protocol member names use camelCase. IDs, revisions and cursors are strings. Timestamps use UTC with milliseconds. Numbers stay within the safe JSON integer magnitude, including in app payloads and open fields. Decoders must reject duplicate members and invalid Unicode. The JSON depth limit counts nested arrays and objects.
x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.evolution: Within v1 preserve required fields, units, defaults and semantics. Add new optional response fields only to open shapes. Breaking wire changes require a new major version and negotiation before use.
x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.admission: Check payload bounds and authenticated identity before dispatch. Recheck current installation generation, user delegation, capability and resource scope at the platform boundary. Bound concurrent requests per installation.
x-rentnerproxy-compatibility.optionalMarketplace: Use separate bounded background requests and keep enrichment outside trusted catalog and installation decisions. Cache or omit enrichment if unavailable. Respect the advertised request size, page and deadline limits.

x-rentnerproxy-runtime-evidence.description: Observed appliances verified both private sockets, generation revocation, frame-bound UI and signed local installation followed by offline startup. These measurements describe the exercised environments. Package admission checks the target and runtime profile on the actual appliance.

AppCredential.description: The manager-issued app direction credential. The platform verifies the app peer UID before calling it. The app validates the credential and generation.

CoreCredential.description: The manager-issued core direction credential. The platform validates the Linux peer UID and credential on each request and authorizes the installation generation for the requested operation.

Generation.name: X-App-Generation
Generation.description: Positive installation generation in canonical decimal form.

Delegation.name: X-App-Delegation
Delegation.description: The platform-issued opaque delegation is required for user-originated work. An explicit service grant governs autonomous operations.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Retry the same input with the original key. Reusing the key with different input conflicts.

ResumeCursor.name: Last-Event-ID
ResumeCursor.description: Resume within the subscription authorized by the current generation, grants, and delegation.
